title: Optometry workshop
body_html:
Consultant ophthalmologists from the Queensland Eye Institute clinical faculty will provide interactive instruction in a free, three-hour workshop developed for practising optometrists.

Learning stations will cover:

  • Corneal foreign body removal at the slit lamp
  • IOL injection into eye models
  • Intravitreal injection technique
  • Basic suturing station
